newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Suquia a Santander strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Suquia a Santander strong buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Argentina's Banco del Suquia with a strong buy recommendation.
-- It estimated a 1998 target share price of $2.58, a 37 percent rise from the current level.
-- Santander expects the bank to report earnings per share of $0.10 in 1997 and $0.25 in 1998, compared with $0.15 in the fiscal year ended on June 30, 1996.
-- "Banco del Suquia has a sound, well-balanced strategy that should boost it into the sphere of national players."

-- "Because Suquia was one of the first entrants into the (Central Argentine) region, we believe that it will be able to fend off competition because of its good customer service, solid technological infrastructure and well-known name in the area.

-- "Asset quality (with a past-due loan ratio of 11.5 percent as of September 1996 versus the private local bank average of 9.7 percent) and low efficiency (67.4 percent for the quarter ended September versus 56.6 percent for Frances and 54.7 percent for Galicia) are concerns.

-- "Nonetheless, the bank's high growth potential (estimated compound annual earnings growth of 44.8 percent over the 1996-2000 period), sound strategy in a region with lower financial penetration and similar GDP per capita to the Greater Buenos Airs area make for an attractive investment opportunity."
